thread:
Anika: Noticing multiple new users hitting unclear errors during quickstart. JS returns generic 'internal server error' with no request id. They're also seeing duplicate POSTs because the client retried on auth failures.

Sam: Ugh. I saw a support case where the initial response was 401, then client retried and second attempt produced 502. User sees only the 502 and no guidance.

Drew: Quick background: Py SDK already has typed exceptions (RedwoodAuthError, RedwoodServerError) with .code and .request_id. JS currently returns plain Error objects and the default HTTP retry middleware retries on 5xx and network errors.

Lena: So parity gap + retry mismatch. That explains the onboarding friction. What's the immediate mitigation?

Anika: Suggested short-term: 1) turn off auto-retry for 401 in JS client, 2) patch server to include request_id in error bodies, 3) add a consistent error JSON field so SDKs can map to typed exceptions.

Sam: Example error shape we discussed in infra sync: {
  "error": { "code": "AUTH_EXPIRED", "message": "API key expired", "retryable": false, "request_id": "req_abc123" }
}

Drew: If the SDK exposes .code and .retryable, apps can make smarter retry decisions. Also useful for our docs and sample app to show best practice: only retry when retryable=true.

Lena: For rollout: can we feature-flag the new error shape? SDKs should gracefully fallback to legacy text-only messages.

Anika: Yes. Plan: backend team will add error-shape feature flag and include request_id always. JS SDK: add TypedError classes and update retry middleware to respect .retryable and not hide original 401. Py team will confirm backwards compat.

Sam: I'll add a tiny unit test in JS asserting no retry on explicit 401 to catch regressions.

Drew: I'll implement the typed exceptions in JS, include fields: code, message, retryable, requestId. Also add mapping table of code->http status in the client so we present consistent errors. ETA 10 business days.

Lena: I'll update the quickstart sample app and the troubleshooting doc to show how to inspect error.requestId and when to rotate keys or surface a user prompt.

deploy-bot: Deployed branch 'feat/error-json' to staging (build 2026-03-21_09:12). URL: https://staging.redwood.ai :rocket: 

Anika: Thanks. Owners: Drew (JS SDK typed exceptions + tests), Sam (unit tests & CI), Lena (docs/sample app), Infra (feature flag). Timeline: feature flag + staging smoke today, SDK PR in ~2w.

Drew: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/990 -- includes TypedError hierarchy and retry middleware update.

Sam: After SDK is published, we'll update onboarding checklist to verify request_id presence in first failed request to support debug flow.

Lena: Agree. Also let's add a short note in release notes about 'better error visibility and retry behavior parity across SDKs'.

Anika: Great. If anyone sees further onboarding error noise, ping #devex and I'll triage. Closing thread.
